stories.title: Il Kennedy Center chiude. La minaccia di Trump: “Al via la ristrutturazione solo con il mio nome”

en.title: Kennedy Center closes. Trump threatens: 'Renovation only with my name'
en.summary: The Kennedy Center board voted to close indefinitely for renovations after a judge blocked Trump's name from being added to the building's facade. Trump called during the meeting and threatened to halt the work unless his name is included.

stories.title: Schengen, l'Italia proroga di 15 giorni il blocco con la Spagna. Madrid: "Inutile e vergognoso"

en.title: Schengen, Italy extends 15-day border block with Spain. Madrid: 'Pointless and shameful'
en.summary: Italy prolonged internal border controls with Spain for 15 additional days citing security concerns. Spain extended reciprocal controls at its ports and airports for Italian travelers through October 8, calling the Italian measures unjustified.

stories.title: Trump, 'ristrutturazione del Kennedy Center solo se c'è il mio nome'

en.title: Trump, 'Kennedy Center renovation only if my name is on it'
en.summary: Trump stated that renovation work at the Kennedy Center cannot begin until the court rules on whether his name can be added to the building's dedication.

stories.title: Kennedy Center verso lo shutdown: il board vota la chiusura immediata dopo il no al nome di Trump

en.title: Kennedy Center headed toward shutdown: board votes immediate closure after rejecting Trump's name
en.summary: The Kennedy Center's board voted to immediately close the cultural center to avoid bankruptcy after a federal court confirmed only Congress can modify the dedication to John F. Kennedy.

stories.title: Salta l'incontro nella nuova casa della famiglia del bosco

en.title: Meeting cancelled at new home for forest family
en.summary: A planned meeting at a new residence provided by the municipality of Palmoli was relocated to a secure location after the area was cleared. The mayor attributed the change to opposition from social services.

stories.title: Madrid, 'Italia su Schengen vergognosa, Meloni e Tajani non all'altezza'

en.title: Madrid: 'Italy's Schengen stance shameful, Meloni and Tajani not up to the task'
en.summary: Spain's Foreign Minister Albares criticized Italy's Schengen decision as absurd and pointless, stating it was driven by internal political motives rather than legitimate concerns.

stories.title: Schengen, altri 15 giorni di stop con la Spagna. Madrid: “Vergogna, Meloni non all’altezza”

en.title: Schengen suspension extended another 15 days with Spain. Madrid: "Shameful, Meloni not up to the task"
en.summary: Italy is extending its Schengen border controls with Spain for another 15 days, citing potential risks from terrorist infiltration, prompting renewed criticism from Spanish officials.

stories.title: Lo "Stabilicum" passa al Senato, ecco cosa prevede la legge elettorale che ora torna alla Camera

en.title: The "Stabilicum" passes the Senate, here's what the new electoral law provides as it returns to the Chamber
en.summary: An electoral law passed the Senate requiring non-parliamentary parties to collect quadruple the number of signatures to run in elections, while established parties gain exemptions.

stories.title: L'Italia proroga di altri 15 giorni il blocco di Schengen con la Spagna. E Madrid fa altrettanto

en.title: Italy extends Schengen border block with Spain for another 15 days. Madrid does the same
en.summary: Italy has prolonged its suspension of the Schengen agreement with Spain for an additional 15 days due to internal security concerns, with Spain reciprocating the measure.

stories.title: Cosa prevede la nuova legge elettorale: preferenze, firme, soglia, tutti i punti della riforma

en.title: What the new electoral law provides: preferences, signatures, threshold, all points of the reform
en.summary: A new electoral reform bill returns to parliament for final approval, with provisions covering voter preferences, candidate signatures, and electoral thresholds under debate.

stories.title: Preferenze, soglia di sbarramento, premio e firme: cosa prevede la nuova legge elettorale

en.title: Preferences, electoral threshold, bonus, and signatures: what the new electoral law provides
en.summary: The new electoral law establishes that a coalition receiving at least 42 percent of votes in both parliamentary chambers gains additional seats, with gender alternation requirements starting from the second candidate.

stories.title: Lituania, jet italiani abbattono drone. Crosetto: “Nostra presenza fondamentale sul fianco est della Nato”

en.title: Lithuania: Italian jets shoot down drone. Crosetto: "Our presence fundamental on NATO's eastern flank"
en.summary: Italian military aircraft downed a drone over Lithuania, with Defense Minister Crosetto emphasizing Italy's strategic role in NATO's eastern defense, while a Russian presidential adviser made threatening statements toward Poland.

stories.title: Tassa sulla CO2: primo ok per i prodotti finiti, ma salta la clausola sui rincari

en.title: CO2 Tax: First Approval for Finished Products, but Price Increase Clause Removed
en.summary: The European Parliament adopted its position on extending the carbon border adjustment mechanism on September 15, approving the mechanism for finished products while removing a clause related to price increases.

stories.title: David Khougazian nuovo amministratore delegato di Chiesi

en.title: David Khougazian new chief executive officer of Chiesi
en.summary: David Khougazian will become the new CEO of the Parma-based group starting October 15, replacing Jean-Marc Bellemin who will continue as CFO.

stories.title: Salone di Genova, sale la presenza di grandi barche fino a 50 metri

en.title: Genoa Boat Show, presence of large yachts up to 50 meters increases
en.summary: The 2026 Genoa International Boat Show will feature increased numbers of large yachts in the 35 to 50 meter range, with overall participation rising by 14.1% compared to 2025.

stories.title: Spaggiari rileva Esds per crescere in America Latina e Penisola Iberica

en.title: Spaggiari acquires Esds to grow in Latin America and Iberian Peninsula
en.summary: Spaggiari, a platform company owned by Ambienta, is acquiring Esds to expand its operations beyond Italy into Latin America and the Iberian Peninsula.

stories.title: Welfare integrativo applicato dal 46% delle imprese liguri

en.title: Supplementary welfare adopted by 46% of Ligurian companies
en.summary: Nearly half of businesses in Liguria have introduced supplementary welfare initiatives beyond national collective agreements, with most planning to maintain or expand these programs.
